title: Project
description: Root configuration of a production/ workspace (production/project.yaml). Global format, style, and provider defaults every command inherits.

production_type.description: Production mode. Selects which rules layer applies: cinema (rules/cinema/, narrative work: short/feature/series) or commercial (rules/commercial/, advertising and social-platform work: spot/social/branded-content/music-video). Defaults to cinema when omitted.

format.description: Delivery format; drives pacing and coverage defaults. short/feature/series belong to production_type cinema; spot/social/branded-content/music-video belong to commercial (enforced by rules, not by this schema).

logline.description: One-sentence summary. Canonical version lives in the story bible.

genre.description: Primary genre label (e.g. noir, drama, sci-fi).

style.description: Global visual-language anchors. Detail lives in the style bible.

look_refs.description: Approved LOOK_* style reference asset IDs.

influences.description: Films, photographers, or art movements that anchor the look.

default_providers.description: Default generation backends per kind; commands may override per run.

lens_kit.description: The project's lens discipline: the finite set of focal lengths shots may use, plus the kit's optical family and character. Limiting the kit is how real productions build visual coherence; shots citing an off-kit focal length are a marked style event needing approval.

focal_lengths_mm.description: Allowed focal lengths in full-frame-equivalent millimeters (e.g. [28, 50, 85]). Single-lens projects are legitimate.

lens_type.description: The kit's default optical family; individual shots may override with approval.

anamorphic_squeeze.description: Squeeze ratio when lens_type is anamorphic.

character.description: The glass's rendering character in prompt-ready language (e.g. "vintage Cooke warmth, gentle halation, soft roll-off" or "modern clinical sharpness").

notes.description: Why this kit: the dramatic argument for the range and its limits.

deliverables.description: Delivery variants. REQUIRED by rules/commercial/platform-deliverables.md when production_type is commercial; optional single-entry list for cinema. Each shot can carry per-deliverable reframing notes.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio for this variant (e.g. 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5).

duration_seconds_max.description: Hard duration ceiling for this variant (e.g. 15, 30, 60).

resolution.description: Delivery resolution for this variant, WIDTHxHEIGHT.

notes.description: Safe areas, caption policy, sound-off assumptions, platform quirks.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace was created.
